card.name: Qualifier word before vaccine/vaccination
card.fires_on: The adjective just before "vaccine" or "vaccination", mostly "live" in immunization warnings, also "herd" and "passive". The next word is expected to be vaccines or a similar term.

modes.label: Live vaccines
modes.description: The word "live" opening a statement about live or live-attenuated vaccines in label warnings.

modes.label: Other qualifiers in news text
modes.description: A modifier such as "herd" or "passive" before a vaccination or smoking term in general web text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about combining and compatibility, such as compatible and combine, which fits warnings about not using vaccines together with a drug.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "vaccines", especially "live" in warnings about live vaccines.
